ja121:0.4: The Spirit in the Clump of Grass: a past life story
ja121:1.1: “Let them befriend an equal, or a better one,
ja121:1.2: let them befriend even a base one, all alone;
ja121:1.3: in distress let them befriend these for the highest good,
ja121:1.4: as I, the clump of grass, being dyed.”
